compatibility.summary: Android 0.10.9 adds read-only inactivity timeout guidance, normal device settings access, and reapplies KEEP_SCREEN_ON on resume. Reviewed Activity diff: enrollment, sync, manifests, cached playback, and APK update contracts are unchanged; existing servers and Pi players remain supported. API 35 native compilation, all 26 native agent/updater/integration tests, repository check, and 22 version/compatibility tests passed. Onn power settings navigation and long-run sleep behavior still require physical device validation.
